nodes.label: Hourly schedule trigger

outputs.name: run_signal
outputs.description: Hourly run signal that starts the Gmail search

nodes.rationale: Declared hourly schedule; emits only a start signal.

nodes.label: Search Gmail for messages with attachments matching the invoice query

outputs.name: matched_emails
outputs.description: Gmail messages that have attachments and match the query 'invoice OR bill OR receipt'

requirement_evidence: searches Gmail for messages that have attachments and match the query 'invoice OR bill OR receipt'
nodes.rationale: Declared external search over Gmail with the specified attachment and keyword filters; deterministic I/O.

nodes.label: Skip emails with no attachments

outputs.name: emails_with_attachments
outputs.description: Emails that carry at least one attachment

requirement_evidence: It skips emails with no attachments
nodes.rationale: Deterministic presence check that drops attachment-less emails; the frozen requirement declares no behavior for the skipped items.

nodes.label: Split emails into individual attachment items

inputs.name: emails_with_attachments
inputs.description: Emails whose attachments are split out

outputs.name: attachment_items
outputs.description: One item per attachment, each carrying the attachment content and its metadata

requirement_evidence: splits each email into individual items so each attachment is processed separately
nodes.rationale: Deterministic fan-out of multi-attachment emails so that each attachment is processed separately.

nodes.label: Extract text from the PDF attachment

inputs.name: attachment_items
inputs.description: PDF attachments processed one at a time

outputs.name: pdf_text
outputs.description: Text extracted from the PDF attachment

requirement_evidence: extract the text from the PDF
nodes.rationale: Deterministic PDF text extraction applied to each attachment item.

nodes.label: Return invoice data as JSON via AI agent

inputs.name: pdf_text
inputs.description: Extracted PDF text sent to the AI agent

outputs.name: invoice_json
outputs.description: Invoice data returned by the AI agent as JSON

requirement_evidence: send the extracted text to an AI agent that returns invoice data as JSON
nodes.rationale: Understanding unstructured invoice text and producing structured fields requires a language model.

nodes.label: Parse and normalize the JSON into a consistent schema

inputs.name: invoice_json
inputs.description: AI-returned JSON to parse and normalize

outputs.name: invoice_record
outputs.description: Normalized invoice record in a consistent schema (invoice number, dates, vendor details, totals, tax) with numeric values converted

requirement_evidence: parse and normalize the JSON into a consistent schema (for example invoice number, dates, vendor details, totals, and tax) and convert numeric values
nodes.rationale: Deterministic parsing, schema normalization and numeric conversion of the AI output.

nodes.label: Append normalized invoice record to Google Sheets tracker

inputs.name: invoice_record
inputs.description: Normalized record appended to the tracker, matched on invoice_number

requirement_evidence: append the normalized invoice record to a Google Sheets tracker, using invoice_number as the matching column
nodes.rationale: User-visible completion action delivering the declared outcome; terminal node with no outgoing CFG edge.

cfg_edges.rationale: The hourly run starts the Gmail search.
Matched emails are filtered for attachments.

cfg_edges.condition: each attachment item is processed separately
cfg_edges.rationale: Each split attachment goes through text extraction.
Extracted text is sent to the AI agent.
The returned JSON is parsed and normalized.
The normalized record is appended to the tracker.

dfg_edges.rationale: The schedule signal starts the Gmail search.
Splitting consumes the emails that carry attachments.
Text extraction runs over each attachment item.
The AI agent consumes the extracted text.
The tracker append consumes the normalized record.

notes: The frozen requirement declares no failure handling, so the following native behaviors were excluded from Gold as undeclared: cross-run deduplication (Check Duplicate), non-PDF routing to a ManualReview sheet (Is PDF? / Flag Unsupported Format / Log Manual Review), error logging to an Errors sheet (Has Error? / Log Errors), and the high-value approval alert (Needs Review? / Send Approval Alert). The native validation of totals inside the parse node also exceeds the declared parse/normalize contract and was not modelled as separate behavior. Per-attachment processing is expressed through the split node's item fan-out rather than an explicit loop node.
